summary: Erie Indemnity Company filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 results and a quarterly dividend. Net income was $180.3 million ($3.45 per diluted share) for Q2, up from $174.7 million ($3.34) year-over-year. The board declared a $1.4625 per share quarterly dividend with payment on October 20, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, strategic review, or other transformative event is present, so no special-situation classification applies.
